def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Repeated full-width or full-height separator lines define a periodic tile.
    row_bars = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_bars = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    # A repeated bar fixes the tile period. Repeat the initial tile, folding
    # non-background marks from matching positions into it.
    if len(row_bars) >= 2:
        period = min(b - a for a, b in zip(row_bars, row_bars[1:]) if b > a)
        if period < h:
            bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
            tile = [row[:] for row in grid[:period]]
            for r in range(h):
                for c in range(w):
                    v = grid[r][c]
                    if v != bg and v != grid[row_bars[0]][0]:
                        k = r % period
                        if tile[k][c] == bg or v == grid[row_bars[0]][0]:
                            tile[k][c] = v
            for r in range(h):
                out[r] = tile[r % period][:]
            return out

    if len(col_bars) >= 2:
        period = min(b - a for a, b in zip(col_bars, col_bars[1:]) if b > a)
        if period < w:
            for c in range(w):
                for r in range(h):
                    out[r][c] = grid[r][c % period]
            return out

    # A single full-width divider between two equal-height panels: duplicate
    # the panel above it into the blank panel below.
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and r == h // 2 and h - r - 1 == r:
            out[r + 1:] = [row[:] for row in grid[:r]]
            return out
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # A single uniform separator between an occupied panel and an empty panel
    # means copy the panel across the separator.
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            if r == h - r - 1 and all(v == grid[r + 1][0] for row in grid[r + 1:] for v in row):
                out[r + 1:] = [row[:] for row in grid[:r]]
                return out
    for c in range(1, w - 1):
        if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1:
            if c == w - c - 1 and all(grid[r][j] == grid[r][c + 1] for r in range(h) for j in range(c + 1, w)):
                for r in range(h):
                    out[r][c + 1:] = grid[r][:c]
                return out

    # Repeated full lines define a tile period. Repeat the tile and propagate
    # any non-background marks observed later at equivalent positions.
    row_bars = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_bars = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    values = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    bg = max(set(values), key=values.count)
    if len(row_bars) >= 2:

        p = min(gaps)

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    vals = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    bg = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)

    # Repeat a tile delimited by repeated full-width/full-height separator lines.
    hlines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    if len(hlines) >= 2:
        gaps = [b-a for a, b in zip(hlines, hlines[1:]) if b > a]
        p = min(gaps)
        tile = [row[:] for row in grid[:p]]
        for r in range(h):
            for c, v in enumerate(grid[r]):
                if v != bg:
                    tile[r % p][c] = v
        return [tile[r % p][:] for r in range(h)]

    vlines = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    if len(vlines) >= 2:
        gaps = [b-a for a, b in zip(vlines, vlines[1:]) if b > a]
        p = min(gaps)
        tile = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(p)] for r in range(h)]
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                v = grid[r][c]
                if v != bg:
                    tile[r][c % p] = v
        return [[tile[r][c % p] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

    # One center separator and an empty, equal-sized panel: copy the filled panel.
    for r in range(1, h-1):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and h-r-1 == r:
            below_empty = all(v == bg for row in grid[r+1:] for v in row)
            above_filled = any(v != bg for row in grid[:r] for v in row)
            if below_empty and above_filled:
                return [row[:] for row in grid[:r]] + [grid[r][:]] + [row[:] for row in grid[:r]]
    for c in range(1, w-1):
        if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and w-c-1 == c:
            right_empty = all(grid[r][j] == bg for r in range(h) for j in range(c+1,w))
            left_filled = any(grid[r][j] != bg for r in range(h) for j in range(c))
            if right_empty and left_filled:
                return [[*row[:c], row[c], *row[:c]] for row in grid]
    return out
